description:
## Channels

FlowConnect helps your team communicate.

Conversations happen in **channels**.

All users with FlowConnect access can view and send messages in **Open** channels.

**Public** channels are visible to everyone, but only members can send messages in them. Any user can join public channels.

**Private** channels are visible only to members, and new members can be added by the channel administrator.

You can also send private **Direct messages**.

Users can create channels and invite the people they need.
